source: The submission deadline has been extended to 23:59 (Anywhere on Earth) on 15 August 2026. Papers that are incomplete at the deadline will not be considered, even if an abstract was registered earlier.
critical_checks: The new deadline is 23:59 Anywhere on Earth on 15 August 2026.
Incomplete papers are excluded despite earlier abstract registration.
The condition and exception must not be reversed.

source: The proposed conformal SIW antenna maintains |S11| below -10 dB from 24.8 to 27.2 GHz under a bending radius of 30 mm. The measured realized gain decreases by only 0.7 dB, indicating that the observed detuning is primarily caused by connector repeatability rather than substrate deformation.
critical_checks: Preserve SIW, |S11|, -10 dB, 24.8–27.2 GHz, 30 mm, and 0.7 dB.
Use established antenna terms for realized gain and detuning.
Connector repeatability, not substrate deformation, is identified as the primary cause.

source: Thank you for the careful revision. Before we can make a final decision, please clarify whether the comparison in Table III uses the same calibration procedure for all baselines. If not, temper the claim of superior accuracy.
critical_checks: The editor asks whether all baselines use the same calibration procedure.
If they do not, the superior-accuracy claim should be weakened rather than removed or strengthened.
Maintain a professional review tone.

source: Could we move Thursday's meeting to 14:30 Beijing time? If that does not work, I am available Friday morning except between 10:00 and 11:00. Please keep Prof. Li copied on the reply.
critical_checks: Thursday is proposed at 14:30 Beijing time.
Friday morning is available except 10:00–11:00.
Prof. Li should remain copied on the reply.

source:
Please send the following before noon:
1. the signed consent form;
2. the raw CSV files, not screenshots; and
3. a one-paragraph explanation of the two excluded trials.
Do not rename the participant IDs.
critical_checks: Preserve all three numbered requirements.
Raw CSV files are required and screenshots are explicitly rejected.
Exactly two excluded trials require a one-paragraph explanation.
Participant IDs must not be renamed.

source: 由于补充实验仍在排队，能否将修改稿提交期限延长至8月12日？我们已经完成正文修改，只剩弯曲半径为20 mm时的重复性测试。若无法延期，我们会按原期限提交现有结果，并在回复信中说明限制。
critical_checks: Request an extension to 12 August because supplementary experiments are queued.
Only the repeatability test at a 20 mm bending radius remains.
If denied, submit existing results by the original deadline and disclose the limitation in the response letter.

source: 该方法并不是利用温度直接补偿谐振频率，而是先根据多通道散射参数估计形变状态，再选择对应的匹配网络。因此，“温度鲁棒”不应被表述为“与温度无关”。
critical_checks: The method does not directly compensate resonant frequency using temperature.
It first estimates deformation from multichannel scattering parameters, then selects a matching network.
Temperature-robust must not be rendered as temperature-independent.

source: 请确认附件中的预算是否已经包含加工费和税费。如果报价仅含材料费，请不要直接下单，先让供应商分别列出三项费用。
critical_checks: Confirm whether processing fees and taxes are included.
Do not place the order if the quotation contains only material costs.
Ask the supplier to itemize all three cost categories first.
